_readme: Bộ ảnh bổ sung cho Motion Kit. Được generate_images.py gộp tự động với image_manifest.json. Dùng chung 'styles' và 'negative' của manifest chính.

styles.backdrop: Soft, abstract, low-detail background photograph or render with very gentle depth of field, large calm areas suitable for placing white text on top after a dark navy overlay. Cool navy (#0B2A6B) and royal blue (#1F5FE0) tones with faint cyan (#5BC8F5) light bokeh. No focal subject that competes with text.

images.section: #contact — ảnh nền mờ phía sau khối liên hệ (dùng .section-bg-wrap)
images.prompt: Blurred wide view of a modern Vietnamese government service centre at dusk, warm interior lights and silhouettes of staff helping citizens at counters, seen through glass, strongly out of focus.

images.section: Khối CTA 'Cùng xây dựng giải pháp…' cuối mỗi trang sản phẩm — ảnh nền mờ dùng chung
images.prompt: Abstract flowing network of thin glowing lines and small nodes forming gentle waves across a deep navy space, suggesting data connecting people, documents and classrooms, very soft and minimal.

images.section: #process — dải minh họa ngay dưới tiêu đề, phía trên 5 bước
images.prompt: Isometric horizontal journey of five connected platforms from left to right: a person surveying shelves of documents with a clipboard, a planning table with blueprints, a small pilot setup of laptops and a display, a training session with a trainer and three learners, and a support desk with a headset and a growing green chart. A single continuous path links the five platforms.
images.alt: Hành trình 5 bước: khảo sát, lập phương án, thí điểm, đào tạo, đồng hành vận hành

images.section: #faq — cột trái (≥1024px) cạnh danh sách câu hỏi; ẩn trên mobile
images.prompt: Isometric scene of a friendly consultant at a desk with a laptop answering questions, floating speech bubbles containing only simple icons (a shield, a server, a calendar, a graduation cap, a coin), a small plant, calm and welcoming.
images.alt: Chuyên gia iViTech giải đáp thắc mắc
